test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,socket,subprocess,threading,http.server,time,os,secrets,yaml,json,http.client,sys,shutil
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();token=secrets.token_hex(8);servers=[];threads=[];proc=None
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.server.label=='provider':
            try:body=(root/'live/http/runtime.json').read_bytes();status=200
            except FileNotFoundError:body=b'{}';status=503
        else:body=(self.server.label+':'+token).encode();status=200
        self.send_response(status);self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json');self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body)));self.end_headers()
        try:self.wfile.write(body)
        except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):pass
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
def start(label):
    srv=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);srv.label=label
    thread=threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever);thread.start();servers.append(srv);threads.append(thread)
    return srv.server_address[1]
def atomic(path,data):
    tmp=path.with_suffix('.next');tmp.write_bytes(data);tmp.replace(path)
def wait(predicate,message):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+4
    while not predicate():
        if time.monotonic()>=deadline:
            detail={host:get(host) for host in ('public.lab.test','private.lab.test')}
            raise AssertionError((message,detail,(root/'native.log').read_text()[-2000:]))
        time.sleep(.04)
try:
    a,b,c,provider=[start(name) for name in ('private','public-old','public-new','provider')]
    with socket.socket() as sock:sock.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=sock.getsockname()[1]
    (root/'live/file').mkdir(parents=True);(root/'live/http').mkdir()
    original_file=(root/'file.yaml').read_bytes();original_http=(root/'http.json').read_bytes()
    def rendered(release,public):
        f=original_file.decode();h=original_http.decode()
        for marker in ('{{PRIVATE_PORT}}','{{RELEASE}}'):assert marker in f
        assert '{{PUBLIC_PORT}}' in h
        return f.replace('{{PRIVATE_PORT}}',str(a)).replace('{{RELEASE}}',release).encode(),h.replace('{{PUBLIC_PORT}}',str(public)).encode()
    oldfiles=rendered('old-'+token,b);newfiles=rendered('new-'+token,c)
    live=[root/'live/file/runtime.yaml',root/'live/http/runtime.json']
    for p,v in zip(live,oldfiles):p.write_bytes(v)
    static={'global':{'checkNewVersion':False,'sendAnonymousUsage':False},'entryPoints':{'web':{'address':f'127.0.0.1:{port}'}},'providers':{'providersThrottleDuration':'50ms','file':{'directory':str(root/'live/file'),'watch':True},'http':{'endpoint':f'http://127.0.0.1:{provider}/config','pollInterval':'100ms','pollTimeout':'300ms'}},'log':{'level':'ERROR'}}
    (root/'static.yaml').write_text(yaml.safe_dump(static))
    with (root/'native.log').open('w') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(['traefik','--configFile='+str(root/'static.yaml')],stdout=log,stderr=log,env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':'1','GOMEMLIMIT':'96MiB'})
        def get(host):
            conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',port,timeout=.3)
            try:
                conn.request('GET','/',headers={'Host':host});res=conn.getresponse();return res.status,res.read().decode(),res.getheader('X-Release')
            except (OSError,http.client.HTTPException):return 0,'',None
            finally:conn.close()
        def expected(release,public_label):return {'public.lab.test':{'body':public_label+':'+token,'release':release+'-'+token},'private.lab.test':{'body':'private:'+token,'release':release+'-'+token}}
        def state(exp):return all(get(host)==(200,values['body'],values['release']) for host,values in exp.items())
        old=expected('old','public-old');new=expected('new','public-new')
        wait(lambda:state(old),'initial real provider namespaces/routing broken')
        pid=proc.pid
        def call(candidates,before,after):
            for name,content in zip(('candidate-file.yaml','candidate-http.json'),candidates):(root/name).write_bytes(content)
            (root/'context.json').write_text(json.dumps({'entry_url':f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}','old':before,'new':after}))
            (root/'rollout.json').unlink(missing_ok=True)
            run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'rollout.py'],capture_output=True,timeout=8)
            report=json.loads((root/'rollout.json').read_text());assert set(report)=={'status'};status=report['status']
            assert (root/'candidate-file.yaml').read_bytes()==candidates[0] and (root/'candidate-http.json').read_bytes()==candidates[1],'candidate files changed'
            return run.returncode,status
        assert call(newfiles,old,new)==(0,'committed'),'valid rollout must commit only after both actual responses'
        assert state(new) and [p.read_bytes() for p in live]==list(newfiles)
        # HTTP provider withdrawal must not fall through to the same-named service in file provider.
        removed=json.loads(newfiles[1]);removed['http'].pop('services');removed=json.dumps(removed).encode()
        atomic(live[1],removed)
        wait(lambda:get('public.lab.test')[0]==404,'missing @http service must fail closed')
        assert get('private.lab.test')==(200,new['private.lab.test']['body'],new['private.lab.test']['release'])
        atomic(live[1],newfiles[1]);wait(lambda:state(new),'provider did not recover')
        before=[p.read_bytes() for p in live]
        assert call((b'http: [',newfiles[1]),new,old)==(2,'rejected'),'malformed YAML must be rejected before touching either live artifact'
        assert [p.read_bytes() for p in live]==before and state(new)
        assert call((b'#'+b'x'*65536+b'\n'+newfiles[0],newfiles[1]),new,new)==(2,'rejected'),'oversized artifact must be rejected before writing'
        assert [p.read_bytes() for p in live]==before and state(new)
        # Correct syntax through a symlink is still outside the artifact input contract.
        (root/'candidate-file.yaml').write_bytes(newfiles[0])
        outside=root/'unrelated-candidate.json';outside.write_bytes(newfiles[1])
        candidate=root/'candidate-http.json';candidate.unlink();candidate.symlink_to(outside)
        (root/'rollout.json').unlink(missing_ok=True)
        run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'rollout.py'],capture_output=True,timeout=8)
        assert run.returncode==2 and json.loads((root/'rollout.json').read_text())=={'status':'rejected'}
        assert candidate.is_symlink() and outside.read_bytes()==newfiles[1] and [p.read_bytes() for p in live]==before
        candidate.unlink()
        broken=(oldfiles[0],removed)
        assert call(broken,new,old)==(1,'rolled_back'),'syntactically valid missing-service candidate needs route verification and rollback'
        assert [p.read_bytes() for p in live]==before and state(new),'both exact old artifacts and live routes must recover'
        assert proc.pid==pid and proc.poll() is None,'do not restart the proxy'
        assert (root/'file.yaml').read_bytes()==original_file and (root/'http.json').read_bytes()==original_http
finally:
    if proc and proc.poll() is None:
        proc.terminate()
        try:proc.wait(timeout=3)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
    for server in servers:server.shutdown();server.server_close()
    for thread in threads:thread.join(2);assert not thread.is_alive()

exercise.operation: 交付file.yaml、http.json和rollout.py。File与HTTP两个Provider均定义名为app的服务；public.lab.test必须明确引用app@http，private.lab.test引用app@file，两个路由使用stamp@file而非HTTP中同名中间件。rollout.py从固定context.json和两个candidate文件读取发布计划，预检JSON/YAML结构及旧路由健康后逐文件原子替换live/file/runtime.yaml和live/http/runtime.json；以真实HTTP响应的正文与X-Release同时确认两条路由，最多3秒收敛才报告committed。候选语法错误拒绝且两份live字节不变；合法语法但路由不健康则恢复两份原字节并验证原路由，报告rolled_back，恢复不成功报告rollback_failed。不能伪造报告、不重启Traefik、不修改候选和模板。
exercise.verification: 可信验收启动真实Traefik3.5 File-watch与HTTP-poll Provider和三个回环后端，检查同名资源跨Provider引用、成功发布两个工件、HTTP服务撤回后公有路由404而私有路由继续正常、恢复Provider、无副作用拒绝坏YAML，以及缺失服务候选触发有界回退和实际响应恢复。端口、后端响应与发布版本动态生成。初始骨架失败；只替换并立即报成功的实现即使成功路径能用，也会在坏候选阶段被拒绝。这里只验证单进程动态配置与失败恢复；两个Provider不存在跨文件原子事务，不声称零中间态或公网零丢包。
failure_examples: app未限定@http会被File中同名app误接管；只验证语法会把缺失服务的候选错误报告committed。
